text:
priya: Heads-up: ran into a config drift during a tenant sweep. console showed 100% applied but router logs show etag mismatch and some hosts never updated.
jonah: ugh. did the console batcher skip any items? which endpoint did you use?
priya: used the bulk-apply flow from Console -> Apply All. POST /api/v1/config/bulk_apply. payload includes etag per-flag.
maya: quick theory: console sends stale etags for flags that were concurrently edited by an automated backfill job. server rejects those but console UI treats them as success if any other flags succeeded in the batch.
leo: that sounds like a UI bug. server returns 409 per-item, we should bubble that up. do we have server-side idempotent semantics?
priya: server is optimistic-locking only. when a 409 occurs we log it and continue. the bulk API returns a mixed result but the Console summaries aggregate by batch and lost the per-flag 409 count.
jonah: risky. two things: 1) console needs a per-flag result view; 2) consider adding a preflight endpoint that simulates the exact apply logic (including coalesce and fast-paths) and returns a deterministic "would_apply" diff so we can catch etag mismatches earlier.
maya: preflight sounds good. must run the same operator code path as apply (we saw earlier that preview uses a simpler evaluator) otherwise false negatives.
leo: agreed. naming: /api/v1/config/preflight?rollout_id=... returns list of {flag, tenant, would_change, server_etag, diff_hash}. make it cheap but consistent.
priya: concern: running full operator logic at scale for many tenants will be heavy. maybe preflight can sample by tenant + support full-run in a shadow-mode (scheduled).
jonah: alternate: preflight can be two-tier: quick-preview (same as existing preview) and full-simulate which can be backgrounded and reported via webhook when finished. that way console shows fast estimate then a definitive confirmation.
maya: we also need a UI affordance: if preflight_server_etag != console_etag, show a red warning and require confirm. do not allow Apply All without resolving mismatches.
leo: ops-bot: can you create a ticket for preflight API + console UX + telemetry changes? tag infra and console teams.
ops-bot: created INF-2444: preflight-simulate-api + console-result-visibility. checklist added: api contract, operator shim, rate-limits, telemetry schema, console patch.
priya: telemetry: add fields `preflight_id`, `preflight_mode=quick|full`, `diff_hash` and `etag_mismatch=true|false` so dashboards can roll up failures.
jonah: wait typo, meant jonah: also add a stable sample key: rollout_id + tenant_id so we can correlate preflight and apply traces.
maya: for the server return format propose compact diff hashes to keep payload small. UI can fetch expanded diffs on demand.
leo: heatmap idea: dashboard showing % of tenants with etag drift per-flag over time. make it a console tab.
priya: I'll prototype the preflight contract in a PR. plan: 1) api PR with quick-preview and async full-simulate 2) backend shim that reuses operator apply code path in read-only mode 3) console change to show per-flag results and block bulk-apply on mismatches 4) telemetry PR.
jonah: timeline?
priya: aiming for api PR tomorrow AM, backend shim by Friday, console follow-up next week.
leo: thanks. small addendum: for any new async full-simulate jobs, cap concurrent runs per org to avoid surprises. also ensure shadow-run does not count against quota meters.
ops-bot: reminder: any new endpoints need openapi update + integration tests.
priya: noted. I'll attach sample logs:
```
WARN router: apply failed tenant=tid-432 etag=0x1a2 expected=0x1b3 code=409 flag=route_priority
```
